systems.system: campagne nationale de délivrance des jugements supplétifs aux enfants sans acte
systems.country_label: campagne nationale de délivrance des jugements supplétifs suivie de transcription aux services d'état civil; audiences foraines
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Administration territoriale (MATGLAC), Direction de l'administration territoriale et des frontières, with OIF technical and financial support
systems.tiers: 12 to 27 November 2025 in 25 of the 117 communes: 5,000 CM2 pupils without a birth act, 200 per commune; mobile court hearings issue supplementary judgments, then transcribed at the civil status centres

note: A late-registration campaign by mobile court hearings: outreach. The ministry says birth registration has been free and the registration rate rising each year since 2022, and announces a larger civil registration programme with the OIF for the following year; nothing on how offices make the record.
